examples.context: Telling a friend you bought tea
examples.lesson: A valid encountered inflection/aspect-bearing occurrence need not exactly equal the dictionary headword. Correcting the headword is not grounds for deleting this source.
Check the exact selected occurrence. Remove the incompatible link without changing the source snapshot or discarding the valid link. Retaining every source is not a correct general policy.
Keep vessel and cupful meanings distinct. A more common alternative such as 杯子 is not by itself evidence that an existing occurrence is invalid.
